summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing that board member Finn Bjørn Ruyter will resign effective September 1, 2026, to focus on his CEO role at Hafslund and other commitments. This is an abrupt board departure, constituting a management change event. No deal terms, pricing, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is routine disclosure under Norwegian securities law. What to watch: potential board replacements and any strategic impact from Ruyter's departure.
